question: How much cost can be removed from the quadratic-only control by omitting unused third-moment arithmetic?
rationale: The marginal degree3 games deliberately retain identical existing arithmetic. An optimized lower-degree control is necessary to assess the practical cost of cubic terms; a masked head does not measure it.
scope: Research-only scalar prototype. Reject nonzero degree3 heads. No model, optimizer, application, search policy or tournament runtime changes.
activation: After the current finite match tail ends, alongside the admitted quadratic score/search oracles. No concurrent benchmark and engine.
decision: Require scalar raw-bit and canonical score parity in all fixed replications. Report actual cost and memory; no search speed claim or trained quadratic strength inference. Do not extend favourable runs.
